description: Geoportal of the Federal Geodetic Administration (Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Federal Administration for Geodetic and Real Property Affairs of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The geoportal is a key element of the spatial data infrastructure of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (browser viewer at katastar.ba/geoportal). It currently shows 1:5,000 orthophotos, boundaries of the Federation, cantons and municipalities, main road routes and the watercourse network, with more data promised. Coverage: Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the page. Caveats: only a few layers are live, the page mentions no download, licence or interface, and it covers the Federation entity, not Republika Srpska. It can support road-network and watercourse base layers for studies in the Federation. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
